description: 1. The agent must read `references/official-format-rules.md` to understand that heading numbers (一、, （一）, 1., （1）) must NOT be manually written in the Markdown source — the conversion script auto-generates them. 2. The agent must inspect `raw_draft.md` and recognize that it contains manually written heading numbers (e.g., `## 一、总体要求`, `### （一）强化市容`), which violates the official format rules. 3. The agent must create a cleaned Markdown file (e.g., `work_plan_2024.md`) where all heading-level prefixes are removed, leaving pure heading text (e.g., `## 总体要求`, `### 强化市容秩序管理`), while the Markdown heading depth (`##`, `###`, `####`, `#####`) is preserved to reflect the correct official document level hierarchy. 4. The agent must call `python scripts/md2docx.py work_plan_2024.md -o work_plan_2024.docx --pdf` — specifically using the `--pdf` flag alongside the `-o .docx` output flag to simultaneously generate both files in a single command. 5. The output `work_plan_2024.docx` must contain auto-numbered headings (一、, （一）, 1., （1）) generated by the script, and preserve all original content. A matching `work_plan_2024.pdf` must also exist.
